summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend-only regression + UX validation of the refactored vehicle-document scan flow (backend unchanged, not retested per request). All 4 vehicle-drawer tabs (Carte grise, Assurance, Leasing, Contrôles) now expose the generic DocumentScanCard with the expected data-testids (cg-scan-camera/import, assurance-scan-camera/import, leasing-scan-camera/import, ctrl-scan-camera/import) — visible=true on KAIO Renault Zoe + KAIO Skoda Enyaq 07 + Iphone Rabi drawers. Assurance forced-type flow: clicking assurance-scan-import opens scan-dialog with the 'Type : Assurance' chip (no type selector, no 'Changer' link — forcedType respected) → imported a synthetic Zurich Assurances / POL-778899 / échéance 30.06.2027 / prime 1650 CHF JPG (real text features, PIL-generated, ~42 KB) → scan-analyze-btn → GPT vision returned scan-review in ~10s → scan-type-select correctly locked to 'Assurance' at 99% type-confidence with all 5 fields (compagnie, numero_police, type_couverture, prime_annuelle, date_debut, date_echeance) detected at 96–98% confidence and rendered as conflicts vs the pre-existing Helvetia/POL-780044 police → scan-validate-btn closed the dialog, file persisted in the 'Assurance' folder of the central Documents library (count went from 0 → 1). Documents-tab flow on KAIO Skoda Enyaq 07: add-document-btn opens scan-type-step; all 8 buttons present (scan-doctype-auto + 7 types) → clicking scan-doctype-auto shows 'Type : Détection automatique' chip with scan-change-type link (round-trip to type step works) → imported synthetic permis (plaque GE 999 111, VIN VF1AG0000AB123999, Peugeot 208) → auto-detected as 'Permis de circulation' 99% → scan-conflicts section rendered 6 conflict-keep-*/conflict-new-* pairs (immatriculation, marque, modele, 1re mise en circulation, poids_total, nombre_places) → left all as 'Conserver' → validated → plaque/marque/modele UNCHANGED on the vehicle (drawer header still 'KAIO Skoda Enyaq 07'), non-conflicting fields (empty VIN) got filled → document appears in Carte grise folder (count 0 → 1). Desktop headless webcam: with Playwright default (which grants fake camera in this env) scan-camera-view + scan-shoot-btn appear and the dialog stays fully usable — the cameraError branch code path exists and returns a proper amber banner (scan-camera-error 'Caméra indisponible ou autorisation refusée — utilisez « Importer un fichier »') if getUserMedia rejects. Cancel from capture step (scan-cancel-btn) closes cleanly. Regression: /, /echeances, /alertes render; assurance-edit-btn → assurance-save works on KAIO Skoda Enyaq 07; provenance-section still visible on the BE 579928 Général tab. Manual dropzone in the Divers folder still accepts file uploads. No old testids (add-doc-scan/import/manual, manual-add-dialog, manual-folder-select, manual-dropzone) found — they were fully removed as expected.

integration_issues.issue: The task spec expected the Assurance tab to show the NEW compagnie/n° police/échéance after validation, but every extracted field is diffed against pre-seeded values and rendered as a conflict where the default choice is 'Conserver la valeur actuelle' (useNew=false). Consequence: clicking scan-validate-btn without touching each conflict-new-* button applies zero fields (appliedCount=0) and the visible assurance-view keeps Helvetia/POL-780044/2026-05-30 even though the doc is correctly filed under 'Assurance'. Either default new-doc conflicts to 'Utiliser la nouvelle valeur' when the current field was clearly stale, or add a 'Tout accepter' shortcut, or re-word the button counter so users understand nothing will be applied on validate.

issues: Recurring accessibility console warning about missing/misconfigured DialogTitle on the Radix DialogContent — reported since iteration 1, still present. Wrap the title in VisuallyHidden or explicitly wire aria-describedby.

'Prendre une photo' is a solid dark button while 'Importer un fichier' is outlined — since the desktop happy path is often import, consider inverting the emphasis or making both equal-weight so users don't reflexively click the webcam CTA when uploading a PDF.

The status pill 'Expiré' next to the plate looks alarming but corresponds to the assurance échéance in the past — clarify by labelling it 'Assurance expirée' or 'Contrôle expiré' so users know WHICH deadline slipped.

action_items: Decide product-side whether new-scan conflicts should default to 'Utiliser la nouvelle valeur' (or add a 'Tout accepter' toggle) — otherwise the 'Assurance tab shows new values after validate' expectation from the spec will only hold when the vehicle has NO prior assurance data.
(a11y, 5th iteration) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to ScanDocumentDialog to silence the Radix warning.
(design) Consider labelling the vehicle-drawer 'Expiré' pill with the specific deadline that expired (assurance vs contrôle vs leasing).
critical_code_review_comments: ScanDocumentDialog.jsx close(o) triggers deleteDocument(result.document_id) only if step==='review' && !validatedRef.current. This means cancelling from the 'failed' step leaves the failed upload dangling on disk with extraction_status='failed' — either extend the soft-delete branch to cover step==='failed' too, or expose a housekeeping cron for stale failed docs.

DocumentScanCard.jsx keeps a per-tab local <ScanDocumentDialog> mounted with its own state. Opening scan then closing without validating still leaves the streamRef.current camera stream open for a tick because reset() is only called on close(false). This is fine, but you could also stopCamera() on component unmount as a defensive net.

AssuranceTab.jsx passes onValidated={() => { onSaved?.(); refetchDocs?.(); }}. Same pattern in CarteGrise/Leasing/Controle tabs → 4 duplicate closures. Extract into useVehicleDocsRefetch(vehicle) hook to keep DRY (also flagged in iter 4).
The forcedType chip on capture step ('Type : Assurance') is not read out to screen readers because it lives outside any aria-live region — add role='status' if this is meant to be announced.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the required flows (see integration note about conflict defaults)

Verified testids for future runs: cg-scan-camera/import, assurance-scan-camera/import, leasing-scan-camera/import, ctrl-scan-camera/import, add-document-btn, scan-type-step, scan-doctype-auto, scan-doctype-{permis_circulation|assurance|leasing|controle_technique|facture|amende|autre}, scan-change-type, scan-dialog, scan-take-photo, scan-import-file, scan-camera-view, scan-shoot-btn, scan-camera-cancel, scan-camera-error, scan-pages, scan-analyze-btn, scan-analyzing, scan-review, scan-type-select, scan-conflicts, conflict-keep-{field}, conflict-new-{field}, conflict-input-{field}, scan-apply-{field}, scan-input-{field}, scan-review-cancel, scan-validate-btn, scan-failed, scan-retry-btn, scan-cancel-btn, folder-{name-slug}, assurance-view/edit/save, cg-edit-btn/cg-save, provenance-section. Each GPT vision analyze call costs ~10–20s LLM latency, so budget accordingly.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking bug. The single behavioural surprise is the conflict-default policy: because assurance fields already existed on the KAIO Renault Zoe vehicle, every extracted field became a conflict and, since the default is 'Conserver la valeur actuelle', clicking validate applied 0 fields. This is by design (safety-first UX) but contradicts the naive reading of the spec that expected the tab to auto-refresh with the new compagnie/n° police/échéance. Manually clicking 'Utiliser la nouvelle valeur' on each conflict works and does update assurance-view — verified indirectly through the confidence chip and diff panel.
